newsitem.title: USA: Ply Gem says board to evaluate offer.
newsitem.headline: Ply Gem says board to evaluate offer.

text.p: PLY GEM Industries Inc said Tuesday its board plans to "promptly" evaluate a proposal from a third party that has proposed buying the company.
PLY GEM said the proposal does not permit it to publicly disclose the name of the bidder at this time.
The company said the proposal calls for PLY GEM's stockholders to receive $19.50 per share in cash for all outstanding shares.
The proposed deal would not be subject to arranging financing.
On June 25, PLY GEM announced it had entered into a definitive merger agreement with Atrium Corp in which PLY GEM stockholders would receive $18.75 per share in cash.
PLY GEM's board has the right to end the Atrium merger agreement on five days' prior notice to Atrium.
The company said the Atrium merger agreement would require it to pay Atrium a fee of $9.5 million and to reimburse Atrium for up to $2.5 million of expenses if it terminated the deal.
